text:
harry_pm: Quick ask from partner (BlueGrid SI). They want a tiny evidence bundle for marketplace ingestion: SOC excerpt, pen-test attestation (vendor-signed), and a clear BYOK/KMS statement proving keys are never exported. They prefer a single presigned object and a short manifest.

sophie_sec: We can provide that. Redaction rules: remove internal hostnames, private IPs, and employee PII. SOC excerpt should be controls list + auditor name only. Pen attestation must be 1 page with vendor + date and scope summary; no technical exploit details.

gopal_partner: Legal needs it by EOD Wednesday. Presigned links OK. They asked for a manifest.json describing owner, ttl_hours, and redaction_status. They also asked that the KMS/BYOK wording explicitly state whether keys are HSM-backed and whether Redwood ever exports keys to partners.

sophie_sec: Suggested KMS sentence: "Redwood uses HSM-backed symmetric CMKs in AWS KMS for service-level encryption of model artifacts. Customers may supply BYOK; Redwood never exports customer key material to partners or third parties. Operational access to CMKs is controlled via IAM roles and audit logged." We'll include a tiny ascii diagram reference and link to an internal architecture doc (private).

harry_pm: Good. Manifest we'll include at tarball root as manifest.json. Example manifest (will be a single-line JSON inside the tarball):
```
{"artifact_name":"bluegrid_compact_bundle.tar.gz","items":["soc2_excerpt_redacted.pdf","pen_attestation_trustassure.pdf","kms_byok_statement.txt","README_marketplace.txt"],"owner":"harry_pm","ttl_hours":"48","redaction_status":"IPs/hostnames/PII removed"}
```

evidence_bot: [automated] Evidence policy: external presign TTL default <= 72h. All artifacts must have an owner and taxonomy tag `marketplace-evidence/compact`. Escalate to compliance@redwood.com for TTL > 90 days.

gopal_partner: They also asked for a one-line attestation confirming the pen test vendor and date. Can you include vendor name in the pen attestation?

sophie_sec: Yes. We have a TrustAssure attestation dated 2025-09-10. We'll prepare a one-page attestation signed by TrustAssure and redact hostnames/IPs.

harry_pm: Action items: (1) @sophie_sec prepare redacted SOC excerpt + one-page TrustAssure attestation + kms_byok_statement.txt, (2) @harry_pm assemble bundle and create presigned S3 object TTL=48h, (3) include manifest.json and README_marketplace.txt with contact security@redwood.com. Target: deliver by 2025-10-01 17:00 PT.

evidence_bot: [automated] Reminder: label object metadata with `marketplace-evidence/compact` and owner=harry_pm. Include manifest.json at tarball root and put README with redaction checklist.

gopal_partner: Perfect. Please DM the presign when ready; legal will verify and then mark listing ready.

sophie_sec: I'll post the attestation for quick redaction review in this thread in ~1 hour.

harry_pm: Thanks team. I'll follow up once presign is live. :white_check_mark:
